## Simulating data

Stochastic simulation to run pup production model with simplified binomial observation process

## Step 1: simulate expected number of pups present across age classes in each colony



```{r}

input_list = list(ndays = 123, amax=123,N=500,
                  mu.bday = 45, sd.bday = 10,
                  mu.s4day = 17, sd.s4day = 5,
                  mu.mday=23,sd.mday=5,
                  mu.lday = 31.5, sd.lday = 7,skew.bday=5,
                  POWhite = 0.98, POMoult = 0.94,PCWhiteS4 = 0.75, PCMoult = 0.82,
                  obsdays = c(65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90))#1:123)#c(35,55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80,85,90, 95,100,105,110))
thisenv <-environment()
list2env(input_list, thisenv)


simSealsS4 <- function(N = 500, 
                       ndays = 123, amax = 123,
                       start = 32, mu.bday = 45, sd.bday = 10, 
                       skew.bday = 5,
                       mu.mday = 23, sd.mday = 5,
                       mu.lday = 31.5, sd.lday = 7,
                       mu.s4day=17,sd.s4day=5,
                       POWhite = 0.98, POWhiteSD = 0.01,
                       POMoult = 0.95, POMoultSD = 0.03,
                       PCWhite = 1, 
                       PCMoult = 0.82, PCMoultSD = 0.09, 
                       PCWhiteS4 = 0.75, PCWhiteS4SD = 0.01,
                       obsdays = 1:123, #c(35,55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80,85,90, 95,100,105,110),
                       obsproc = "normappx",seed=2024) {  

  set.seed(seed)

    #skew normal birth curve
    dskewnorm <- function(x,skew.bday,mu.bday,sd.bday) {
      Pb <- rep(0,ndays)  
      #x=1:123
      delta <- skew.bday/sqrt(1+(skew.bday^2))
      
      omega <- sqrt(sd.bday^2/(1-(2*delta^2)/pi))
      
      xi <- mu.bday - omega*delta*sqrt(2/pi)
      Pb <- (2/omega)*dnorm((x-xi)/omega) * pnorm(skew.bday*((x-xi)/omega))
      
      # Return the probability vector
      return(Pb)
    }
    
    # Integrate over days of season for prob of being born on each day
    integratePb <-  function(ndays,skew.bday,mu.bday,sd.bday) {
      # Initialize Pb as a parameter of the same length as ndays
      Pb <- rep(0, ndays)
      
      for (t in 2:ndays) {
        # Define the start and end of the interval
        start <- t-1   
        end <-  t
        
        # Integrate over the interval and add to the probability for this day
        Pb[t] <- Pb[t] + integrate(dskewnorm,skew.bday=skew.bday,mu.bday=mu.bday,sd.bday=sd.bday, start, end)$value
      }
      
      return(Pb)
    }
    
    Pb <- integratePb(ndays,skew.bday,mu.bday,sd.bday)
    # make sure area under curve sums to 1
    Pb <- Pb/sum(Pb)

  #=============================================================================
  ###
  ### TRANSITION PROBABILITIES
  ###
  ### calculate the probability of transitioning into moulting (PS4) or complete 
  ### moult (Pm) on any given day by subtracting the CDF on current day from 
  ### previous day to get PS4 and Pm for current day: 
  #=============================================================================
  PS4 <- rep(0, amax)
  
  ###  PS4 as function of age
  PS4<- pnorm(1:amax, mu.s4day, sd.s4day) - pnorm(0:(amax - 1), mu.s4day, sd.s4day)
  
  PS4 <- PS4/sum(PS4)
  
  
  Pm<- rep(0, amax)
  # #Calculate probability of moulting as a function of age
  Pm <- pnorm(1:amax, mu.mday, sd.mday) - pnorm(0:(amax - 1), mu.mday, sd.mday)
  #Ensure probabilities sum to 1
  Pm <- Pm / sum(Pm)
  
  #Calculate probability of leaving as a function of age
  Pl <- pnorm(1:amax, mu.lday, sd.lday) - pnorm(0:(amax - 1), mu.lday, sd.lday)
  #Ensure probabilities sum to 1
  Pl <- Pl / sum(Pl)
  
   
  
  # generate pups and transitions

    realBorn <- 0
    
    #The t function transposes this matrix, so each row of realBorn represents a draw.
    realBorn <- as.numeric(t(rmultinom(1, size = N, prob = Pb)))
    realS4 <- matrix(rep(0, ndays * amax), nrow = ndays, ncol = amax)
    for (i in 1:ndays){
      
      while(sum(realS4[i,]) != sum(realBorn[i])){
        realS4[i,] <- rbinom(n = amax, size = realBorn[i], prob = PS4)
      }
      
    }
    
    s4vec <- rep(0, ndays)
    tmin <- min(which(realBorn!=0))
    
    #take upper triangular of realS4
    for (i in tmin:ndays){
      
      
      s4v <- 0
      rowmax <- i - tmin + 1
      
      for (j in tmin:i){
        for (k in 1:rowmax){
          
          s4v <- sum(s4v, realS4[j, k])
          
        } # end for k
        
        rowmax <- rowmax - 1
      }
      
      s4vec[i] <- s4v
    } # end for i
    cumS4<-s4vec
   
    
    realMoult = array(data = 0, dim = c(ndays,amax,amax))
    for (dob in 1:nrow(realS4)) {
      for (age in 1:ncol(realS4)) {
        realMoult[dob,age,] <- as.vector(rmultinom(1, size = realS4[dob,age], prob = Pm))
      }
    }
    
    realMoult2d = apply(realMoult, c(1,3), sum)
    dayMoult = matrix(0, nrow = ndays, ncol = amax)
    
    for(dob in 1:nrow(realMoult2d)){
      for(dom in 1:ncol(realMoult2d)){
        day_moult = min(dom + dob - 1,123)
        dayMoult[dob,day_moult] = dayMoult[dob,day_moult] + realMoult2d[dob,dom]
      }
    }
    
    cumMoult<-cumsum(apply(dayMoult, 2, sum))
    
    
    #
    # calculate pups that leave conditional on having moulted
    #
    realLeave = array(data = 0, dim = c(ndays,amax,amax))
    for (dob in 1:nrow(realMoult)) {
      for (age in 1:ncol(realMoult)) {
        realLeave[dob,age,] <- as.vector(rmultinom(1, size = realMoult2d[dob,age], prob = Pl)) #PmPl2$PlGivenm))
      }
    }
    
    realLeave2d = apply(realLeave, c(1,3), sum)
    dayLeave = matrix(0, nrow = ndays, ncol = amax)
    
    for(dob in 1:nrow(realLeave2d)){
      for(dol in 1:ncol(realLeave2d)){
        day_leave = min(dol + dob - 1,123)
        dayLeave[dob,day_leave] = dayLeave[dob,day_leave] + realLeave2d[dob,dol]
      }
    }
    
    cumLeave<-cumsum(apply(dayLeave, 2, sum))
    
    whitePups<- cumsum(realBorn) - cumS4
    S4Pups <- cumS4-cumMoult
    moultPups <- cumMoult - cumLeave
    leavePups<-colSums(dayLeave)
    allPups <- cumsum(realBorn) - cumLeave
    
  

  if (obsproc == "normappx"){
    
    # ## POBS ONLY
    sdwhite <- sqrt((whitePups +S4Pups) * POWhite * (1 - POWhite))
    
    sdmoult <- sqrt(moultPups * POMoult * (1 - POMoult))
    
    whiteCount <- rnorm(n = length(whitePups), mean=(whitePups+S4Pups)*POWhite, sd=sdwhite)
    
    moultCount <- rnorm(n = length(moultPups), mean= moultPups * POMoult, sd=sdmoult)
    
    
    #Add misclassification 
    # sdwhite <- sqrt(whitePups * POWhite * (1 - POWhite) +
    #                   moultPups * (1 - PCMoult) * POMoult * (1 - (1 - PCMoult) * POMoult) +
    #                   S4Pups * POWhite * PCWhiteS4 * (1 - POWhite*PCWhiteS4))
    # 
    # sdmoult <- sqrt(moultPups * POMoult * PCMoult * (1 - POMoult * PCMoult) +
    #                   S4Pups*POWhite*(1-PCWhiteS4)*(1 - POWhite*(1-PCWhiteS4)))
    # 
    # whiteCount <- rnorm(n = length(whitePups), mean=whitePups * POWhite +
    #                       moultPups * POMoult * (1 - PCMoult)+
    #                       S4Pups*POWhite*PCWhiteS4, sd=sdwhite)
    # 
    # moultCount <- rnorm(n = length(moultPups), mean= moultPups * POMoult * PCMoult +
    #                       S4Pups*POWhite*(1-PCWhiteS4), sd=sdmoult)

  }
  
  if (obsproc == "binom"){
    
    white1_4<-whitePups+S4Pups
    whiteCount <- rbinom(n=length(white1_4), size =(white1_4), POWhite)
    moultCount <- rbinom(n=length(moultPups), size =(moultPups), POMoult)
    
    # whiteC <- whitePups + moultPups*(1-PCMoult)+ S4Pups*PCWhiteS4
    # moultC <- moultPups*PCMoult +S4Pups*(1-PCWhiteS4)
    # 
    # # pups counted as white or moulted come from a binomial with size= all pups classified
    # # into that age stage and probability of observing them (which is influenced by their classification)
    # whiteCount <- rbinom(n=length(whiteC), size =(round(whiteC)), POWhite)
    # moultCount <- rbinom(n=length(moultC), size =(round(moultC)), POWhite)
    

  }
  

  # simulated observation data of white and moulted:
  wObs <- whiteCount[obsdays]
  mObs <- moultCount[obsdays]
  
  sim.out <- list( realBorn = realBorn, Pb = Pb,PS4=PS4,Pm = Pm,
                   # whiteObs = whiteObs, moultObs = moultObs,
                   wObs = wObs, mObs = mObs, white1_4=whitePups+S4Pups,
                   whitePups=whitePups,S4Pups=S4Pups,moultPups=moultPups,leavePups=leavePups)
  list2env(sim.out, globalenv())
  return(sim.out)
  
}

sim_S4<-simSealsS4()



# Check for negative values in the calculated stages
check_negative <- function(stage, stage_name) {
  if (any(stage < 0)) {
    warning(paste("Negative values found in", stage_name))
  } else {
    print(paste("No negative values in", stage_name))
  }
}

check_negative(sim_S4$whitePups, "whitePups")
check_negative(sim_S4$S4Pups, "S4Pups")
check_negative(sim_S4$moultPups, "moultPups")
check_negative(sim_S4$leavePups, "leavePups")
```

## Observation process

Now simulate binomial observation process with observation error only (no misclassifications) and overlay with expected pups
```{r}
# binomial obs process 
 # white1_4<-whitePups+S4Pups
 #    whiteCount <- rbinom(n=length(white1_4), size =(white1_4), POWhite)
 #    moultCount <- rbinom(n=length(moultPups), size =(moultPups), POMoult)
    sdwhite <- sqrt((sim_S4$whitePups +sim_S4$S4Pups) * POWhite * (1 - POWhite))
    
    sdmoult <- sqrt(sim_S4$moultPups *POMoult * (1 - POMoult))
    
    whiteCount <- rnorm(n = length(sim_S4$whitePups), mean=((sim_S4$whitePups+sim_S4$S4Pups)*POWhite), sd=sdwhite)
    
    moultCount <- rnorm(n = length(sim_S4$moultPups), mean=(sim_S4$moultPups * POMoult), sd=sdmoult)
    wObs <-whiteCount
    mObs <-moultCount
    
```

## Nimble model

```{r}



library(nimble)

## choose dataset
## 1: my random data
## 2: your simulated (sim_S4) data
useData <- 2

dskew <- nimbleFunction(
    run = function(x = double(1), param = double(1)) {
        skew.bday <- param[1]
        mu.bday   <- param[2]
        sd.bday   <- param[3]
        delta <- skew.bday/sqrt(1+(skew.bday^2))
        omega <- sqrt(sd.bday^2/(1-(2*delta^2)/pi))
        xi <- mu.bday - omega*delta*sqrt(2/pi)
        pb <- (2/omega)*dnorm((x-xi)/omega) * pnorm(skew.bday*((x-xi)/omega))
        returnType(double(1))
        return(pb)
    })

int_pb <- nimbleFunction(
    run = function(ndays = double(), skew.bday = double(), mu.bday = double(), sd.bday = double()) {
        pb <- numeric(ndays)
        pars <- c(skew.bday, mu.bday, sd.bday)
        for(t in 1:ndays) {
            pb[t] <- nimIntegrate(dskew, t-1, t, pars)[1]
        }
        returnType(double(1))
        return(pb)
    })

dIndividual <- nimbleFunction(
    run = function(x = double(1), pb = double(1), ps = double(1), pm = double(1), pl = double(1), log = integer(0, default = 0)) {
        ## x: (born day, stage4 day, moult day, leave day)
        ndays <- length(pb)
        lp <- 0
        if(0 < x[1] & x[1] < x[2] & x[2] < x[3] & x[3] < x[4] & x[4] <= ndays) {
            age_s <- x[2] - x[1] + 1
            age_m <- x[3] - x[1] + 1
            age_l <- x[4] - x[1] + 1
            lp <- log(pb[x[1]]) + log(ps[age_s]) + log(pm[age_m]) + log(pl[age_l])
        }
        returnType(double())
        if(log) return(lp) else return(exp(lp))
    })

rIndividual <- nimbleFunction(
    run = function(n = integer(), pb = double(1), ps = double(1), pm = double(1), pl = double(1)) {
        stop('not implemented')
        returnType(double(1))
        return(c(1,2,3,4))
    })

registerDistributions(
    list(dIndividual = list(
             BUGSdist = 'dIndividual(pb, ps, pm, pl)',
             types = c('value = double(1)', 'pb = double(1)', 'ps = double(1)', 'pm = double(1)', 'pl = double(1)'),
             discrete = TRUE,
             mixedSizes = TRUE,
             pqAvail = FALSE
         ))
)

calcDaily_boundary <- nimbleFunction(
    run = function(ndays = double(), z = double(1)) {
        ans <- numeric(ndays)
        for(t in 1:ndays)   ans[t] <- sum(z == t)
        returnType(double(1))
        return(ans)
    }
)

calcDaily_intermediate <- nimbleFunction(
    run = function(ndays = double(), z = double(2)) {
        ans <- numeric(ndays)
        for(t in 1:ndays)   ans[t] <- sum(  (z[,1] <= t)  &  (z[,2] > t)  )
        returnType(double(1))
        return(ans)
    }
)

sampler_add_remove <- nimbleFunction(
    name = 'sampler_add_remove',
    contains = sampler_BASE,
    setup = function(model, mvSaved, target, control) {
        tries <- if(!is.null(control$tries)) control$tries else 1
        calcNodes <- model$getDependencies(target)
        if(target != 'z')  stop('target should only be z node')
        ndays <- length(model$pb)
        M <- dim(model$z)[1]
        totalTries <- 0
        totalAccept <- 0
        totalAdd <- 0
        totalRemove <- 0
    },
    run = function() {
        for(i in 1:tries) {
            lp0 <- model$getLogProb(calcNodes)
            nInd <- model$nInd[1]
            a <- runif(1)
            if(a < 0.5) {  ## propose adding an individual
                if(nInd == M) { print('Error: trying to add an individual, already M individuals in model, MCMC invalid'); return() }
                z_new <- generate_z()
                model$z[nInd+1,] <<- z_new
                lpFwd <- dIndividual(z_new, model$pb, model$ps, model$pm, model$pl, 1)
                lpRev <- -log(nInd+1)
            } else {              ## propose removing an individual
                ind <- ceiling(nInd*runif(1))
                z_old <- model$z[ind,]
                model$z[ind,] <<- model$z[nInd,]
                model$z[nInd,] <<- c(0, 0, 0, 0)
                lpFwd <- -log(nInd)
                lpRev <- dIndividual(z_old, model$pb, model$ps, model$pm, model$pl, 1)
            }
            lp1 <- model$calculate(calcNodes)
            logMHR <- lp1 + lpRev - lp0 - lpFwd
            jump <- decide(logMHR)
            if(jump) nimCopy(from = model, to = mvSaved, row = 1, nodes = calcNodes, logProb = TRUE)
            else     nimCopy(from = mvSaved, to = model, row = 1, nodes = calcNodes, logProb = TRUE)
            ## diagnostics:
            totalTries <<- totalTries + 1
            if(jump) {
                totalAccept <<- totalAccept + 1
                if(a < 0.5)   totalAdd <<- totalAdd + 1   else   totalRemove <<- totalRemove + 1
            }
        }
    },
    methods = list(
        generate_z = function() {
            z_new <- numeric(4)
            z_new[1] <- ceiling(ndays*runif(1))
            z_new[2] <- ceiling(ndays*runif(1))
            while(z_new[2] == z_new[1])   z_new[2] <- ceiling(ndays*runif(1))
            z_new[3] <- ceiling(ndays*runif(1))
            while(z_new[3] == z_new[1] | z_new[3] == z_new[2])   z_new[3] <- ceiling(ndays*runif(1))
            z_new[4] <- ceiling(ndays*runif(1))
            while(z_new[4] == z_new[1] | z_new[4] == z_new[2] | z_new[4] == z_new[3])   z_new[4] <- ceiling(ndays*runif(1))
            ## sort:
            for(i in 1:3)   if(z_new[i] > z_new[i+1])   z_new[i:(i+1)] <- c(z_new[i+1], z_new[i])
            for(i in 1:3)   if(z_new[i] > z_new[i+1])   z_new[i:(i+1)] <- c(z_new[i+1], z_new[i])
            for(i in 1:3)   if(z_new[i] > z_new[i+1])   z_new[i:(i+1)] <- c(z_new[i+1], z_new[i])
            returnType(double(1))
            return(z_new)
        },
        reset = function() {
            totalTries <<- 0
            totalAccept <<- 0
            totalAdd <<- 0
            totalRemove <<- 0
        }
    )
)

sampler_modify <- nimbleFunction(
    name = 'sampler_modify',
    contains = sampler_BASE,
    setup = function(model, mvSaved, target, control) {
        tries <- if(!is.null(control$tries)) control$tries else 1
        calcNodes <- model$getDependencies(target)
        if(target != 'z')  stop('target should only be z node')
        ndays <- length(model$pb)
        z_new <- numeric(4)
        totalTries <- 0
        totalAccept <- 0
    },
    run = function() {
        for(i in 1:tries) {
            nInd <- model$nInd
            ind <- ceiling(nInd*runif(1))
            index <- ceiling(4*runif(1))
            delta <- 2*floor(2*runif(1))-1
            for(j in 1:4)   z_new[j] <<- model$z[ind,j][1]
            z_new[index] <<- z_new[index] + delta
            valid <- 0 < z_new[1] & z_new[1] < z_new[2] & z_new[2] < z_new[3] & z_new[3] < z_new[4] & z_new[4] <= ndays
            if(valid) {
                lp0 <- model$getLogProb(calcNodes)
                model$z[ind,] <<- z_new
                lp1 <- model$calculate(calcNodes)
                logMHR <- lp1 - lp0
                jump <- decide(logMHR)
                if(jump) nimCopy(from = model, to = mvSaved, row = 1, nodes = calcNodes, logProb = TRUE)
                else     nimCopy(from = mvSaved, to = model, row = 1, nodes = calcNodes, logProb = TRUE)
            } else jump <- FALSE
            ## diagnostics:
            totalTries <<- totalTries + 1
            if(jump)   totalAccept <<- totalAccept + 1
        }
    },
    methods = list(
        reset = function() {
            totalTries <<- 0
            totalAccept <<- 0
        }
    )
)

########################################################################
################# insert your simulated / real data here ###############
########################################################################

## option 1
## random data:
if(useData == 1) {
    ndays <- 30
    wObs <- c(1, 1, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 3, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    mObs <- c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 5, 5, 4, 2, 2, 5, 2, 1)
    obsdays <- 5:21
}

## option 2
## simulated data:
if(useData == 2) {
    sim_S4 <- simSealsS4()
    wObs <- sim_S4$wObs
    mObs <- sim_S4$mObs
    ndays <- length(wObs)
    obsdays <- 1:123 #c(65, 70, 75, 80,85,90)#1:length(wObs)
}

########################################################################
########################################################################

code <- nimbleCode({
    # mu.bday ~ dunif(20, 60)
    # skew.bday ~ dunif(5, 8)
    # sd.bday ~ dunif(10, 12)
  
    mu.bday ~ dunif(0, ndays)
    skew.bday ~ dunif(0, ndays)
    sd.bday ~ dunif(0, ndays)
    mu.sday ~ dunif(0, ndays)
    sd.sday ~ dunif(0, ndays)
    mu.mday ~ dunif(0, ndays)
    sd.mday ~ dunif(0, ndays)
    mu.lday ~ dunif(0, ndays)
    sd.lday ~ dunif(0, ndays)

    pb[1:ndays] <- int_pb(ndays, skew.bday, mu.bday, sd.bday)
    
    ps1[1:ndays] <- pnorm(1:ndays, mu.sday, sd.sday) - pnorm(0:(ndays-1), mu.sday, sd.sday)
    ps[1:ndays] <- ps1[1:ndays]/sum(ps1[1:ndays])
    
    pm1[1:ndays] <- pnorm(1:ndays, mu.mday, sd.mday) - pnorm(0:(ndays-1), mu.mday, sd.mday)
    pm[1:ndays] <- pm1[1:ndays]/sum(pm1[1:ndays])
    
    
    pl1[1:ndays] <- pnorm(1:ndays, mu.lday, sd.lday) - pnorm(0:(ndays-1), mu.lday, sd.lday)
    pl[1:ndays] <- pl1[1:ndays]/sum(pl1[1:ndays])
    
    POWhite ~ dunif(.5, 1)
    POMoult ~ dunif(.5, 1)
    # PCMoult ~ dunif(.5, 1)
    # PCStge4 ~ dunif(.5, 1)
    ##
    cons[1] ~ dconstraint(mu.sday < mu.mday)
    cons[2] ~ dconstraint(mu.mday < mu.lday)
    ##
    for(i in 1:M)   z[i, 1:4] ~ dIndividual(pb[1:ndays], ps[1:ndays], pm[1:ndays], pl[1:ndays])
    ##
    bornDaily [1:ndays] <- calcDaily_boundary    (ndays, z[1:M,1  ])
    whiteDaily[1:ndays] <- calcDaily_intermediate(ndays, z[1:M,1:2])
    stge4Daily[1:ndays] <- calcDaily_intermediate(ndays, z[1:M,2:3])
    moultDaily[1:ndays] <- calcDaily_intermediate(ndays, z[1:M,3:4])
    leaveDaily[1:ndays] <- calcDaily_boundary    (ndays, z[1:M,  4])
    nInd <- sum(bornDaily[1:ndays])
    ##
    ###########################################################################
    ###
    ### OBSERVATION PROCESSES
    ###
    ###########################################################################
    
    #Binomial obs only
    
    #white1_4[1:ndays] <- whiteDaily[1:ndays] + stge4Daily[1:ndays]
    # for(i in 1:length(obsdays)) {
    #   # no classification
    #   wObs[i] ~ dbinom(POWhite,white1_4[i])
    #   mObs[i] ~ dbinom(POMoult,moultDaily[i])
    # }
    
    
    # norm appx with obs error only 
    for(i in 1:length(obsdays)) {
      whiteM[i] <- whiteDaily[obsdays[i]] * POWhite               + stge4Daily[obsdays[i]] * POWhite
      whiteV[i] <- whiteDaily[obsdays[i]] * POWhite * (1-POWhite) + stge4Daily[obsdays[i]] * POWhite *(1-POWhite)
      whiteS[i] <- max(sqrt(whiteV[i]), 0.00000001)
      moultM[i] <- moultDaily[obsdays[i]] * POMoult
      moultV[i] <- moultDaily[obsdays[i]] * POMoult * (1-POMoult)
      moultS[i] <- max(sqrt(moultV[i]), 0.00000001)
      wObs[i] ~ dnorm(round(whiteM[i]), sd = whiteS[i])
      mObs[i] ~ dnorm(round(moultM[i]), sd = moultS[i])
    }
    
    
    
    #add misclassification
    # for(i in 1:length(obsdays)) {
    #     whiteM[i] <- whiteDaily[obsdays[i]] * POWhite               + stge4Daily[obsdays[i]] * POWhite*PCStge4                       + moultDaily[obsdays[i]] * POMoult*(1-PCMoult)
    #     whiteV[i] <- whiteDaily[obsdays[i]] * POWhite * (1-POWhite) + stge4Daily[obsdays[i]] * POWhite*PCStge4 * (1-POWhite*PCStge4) + moultDaily[obsdays[i]] * POMoult*(1-PCMoult) * (1-POMoult*(1-PCMoult))
    #     whiteS[i] <- max(sqrt(whiteV[i]), 0.00000001)
    #     moultM[i] <- stge4Daily[obsdays[i]] * POWhite*(1-PCStge4)                         + moultDaily[obsdays[i]] * POMoult*PCMoult
    #     moultV[i] <- stge4Daily[obsdays[i]] * POWhite*(1-PCStge4)*(1-POWhite*(1-PCStge4)) + moultDaily[obsdays[i]] * POMoult*PCMoult * (1-POMoult*PCMoult)
    #     moultS[i] <- max(sqrt(moultV[i]), 0.00000001)
    #     wObs[i] ~ dnorm(whiteM[i], sd = whiteS[i])
    #     mObs[i] ~ dnorm(moultM[i], sd = moultS[i])
    # }

})

M <- max(ceiling(max(wObs+mObs) * 1.2), 20)       ## maximum possible number of individuals this model will allow
constants <- list(ndays = ndays, M = M, obsdays = obsdays)#,POWhite=POWhite,POMoult=POMoult,PCStge4=0.75,PCMoult=PCMoult)
data <- list(wObs = wObs, mObs = mObs, cons = c(1,1))
z_init <- array(0, c(M,4))

if(useData == 1) {    for(i in 1:15 )   z_init[i,1:4] <- c( 5, 10, 13,  22)    }
if(useData == 2) {    for(i in 1:400)   z_init[i,1:4] <- c(25, 40, 55, 120)    }
#if(useData == 2) {    for(i in 1:400)   z_init[i,1:4] <- c(65, 70, 75, 80)    }
#if(useData == 2) {    for(i in 1:400)   z_init[i,1:4] <- c(45, 62, 68, 76)    }
#if(useData == 2) {    for(i in 1:400)   z_init[i,1:4] <- c(69, 70, 71, 72)    }

# Dt inits for data 1 with uninformative priors
inits=list(
      # mu.bday=45,
      # sd.bday=10,
      # skew.bday=5,
      # mu.sday = 17,
      # sd.sday = 10,
      # mu.mday = 23,
      # sd.mday = 5,
      # mu.lday =31.5,
      # sd.lday = 7,
    mu.bday = (1/5) * ndays,
    skew.bday = 2,
    sd.bday = 20,
    mu.sday = (2/5) * ndays,
    sd.sday = 20,
    mu.mday = (3/5) * ndays,
    sd.mday = 20,
    mu.lday = (4/5) * ndays,
    sd.lday = 20,
    POWhite = 0.9,
    POMoult = 0.9,
    # PCMoult = 0.9,
    # PCStge4 = 0.9,
    z = z_init
)

Rmodel <- nimbleModel(code, constants, data, inits)
# calculate() provides the log likelihood of the model 
# the closer to zero the log-likelihood, the better the model fits the data.
Rmodel$calculate()   ## make sure this gives you a real number (not NaN or -Inf)

conf <- configureMCMC(Rmodel, nodes = Rmodel$getNodeNames(topOnly = TRUE))
conf$addMonitors('nInd')
conf$addSampler('z', 'add_remove', tries = 10)
conf$addSampler('z', 'modify',     tries = 10)

Rmcmc <- buildMCMC(conf)
#runMCMC(Rmcmc,niter=1)
Cmodel <- compileNimble(Rmodel)
Cmcmc <- compileNimble(Rmcmc, project = Rmodel)

set.seed(0)
samples <- runMCMC(Cmcmc, niter = 5000, nburnin = 1000, thin = 5)
```
